newsitem.title: USA: APS gets waiver from senior lenders.
newsitem.headline: APS gets waiver from senior lenders.

text.p: APS Holding Corp said Monday it had obtained a waiver from its senior lenders on compliance with its consolidated leverage ratio requirement for the first quarter.
The waiver will be effective until July 15, APS said.

APS said it intends to propose to its senior lenders that the leverage ratio and certain other financial covenants in its credit agreement be amended, based on the company's first quarter results and the outlook for results for the remainder of its fiscal year 1998, which began January 26.

The company said its senior lenders have been supportive of the company in the past, and APS believes they will be receptive to considering any appropriate changes, although no assurance can be given in this regard.
